public interface UnmodifiableBean
Marker interface implemented by the nested Unmodifiable snapshot variants of the HTTP bean families.

Immutability across the HTTP bean hierarchies is expressed with a "funnel + nested Unmodifiable snapshot" paradigm: every state change on a bean is routed through a single protected modify(Runnable) choke-point, and each concrete class gets a nested X.Unmodifiable extends X whose only behavioral override is a throwing modify(...). Because there is no single common Unmodifiable supertype across all leaves, this empty marker gives isUnmodifiable() a single type check that works uniformly across every family and both the canonical and classic stacks:

public boolean isUnmodifiable() { return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean; }

  • Method Details

    • logicalType

      static Class<?> logicalType(Object o)
      Returns the "logical" (declared) type of the specified object, unwrapping the internal X.Unmodifiable snapshot subclass when present.

      The nested X.Unmodifiable snapshot classes are an internal implementation detail of the immutability paradigm. Any code that reports or keys on a bean's runtime type over the wire (e.g. the Thrown response header) must use the logical type so that a frozen BadRequest.Unmodifiable still reports as BadRequest.

      Parameters:
      o - The object. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The declared type — the immediate superclass for an UnmodifiableBean, otherwise the runtime class.
